title: Agreement preserves probability
statement: Let $m\in\mathbb{N}$ and let $A$ and $B$ be predicates on Boolean words. If $A$ and $B$ agree on every Boolean word of length $m$, then their probabilities on a uniformly random Boolean word of length $m$ are equal.
hypotheses_covered: For every Boolean assignment of length $m$, $A$ and $B$ agree
